The Title Villa Kirara

Villa in Cherng Talay
HomeSaleThe Title Villa Kirara

Project overview

Villa Kirara is a pool-villa enclave by The Title Residence, offered in five plan types (Aura, Selene, Lyra, Myrrah, Xenia) with 360-degree virtual tours. The developer's site reports construction progress at 15.03% as of October 2026, with piling complete.

The Title Villa Kirara: key facts

  • The Title Villa Kirara is a pool villa in Cherng Talay, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC.
  • Units: 3–4 bedrooms, 328–660 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Dec 2027.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿29,020,000.
  • Nearest beach: Bang Tao Beach (4.1 km, straight line).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Bang Tao Beach (4.1 km, straight line); Thalang Hospital (5.1 km, straight line); Wattanapat Hospital Phuket (5.5 km, straight line); Choeng Thale Fresh Fruit Market (2.4 km, straight line).
  • More projects by Rhom Bho Property in our catalogue: Darayana Kamala, The Title Cocoon, The Title Adora Rawai, Biancana, Casa De Monte, Coralina Kamala.
